extracted.summary: A centrally sponsored scholarship offering financial assistance to post-matriculation and post-secondary level OBC students domiciled in Delhi.
extracted.amount_text: Day scholars receive INR 260 to INR 750 per month. Hostelers receive INR 160 to INR 350 per month. Full Tuition Fee, Registration Fee and Examination Fee as applicable.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: Applicants must have secured an attendance of at least 75% in the previous year.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have an annual parent or guardian income of not more than INR 1,00,000.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to the OBC category.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be domiciled in Delhi.
